label: Confluence → Knowledge Base
description: Hourly poll of a Confluence space. Lists pages in the space and loads each into the configured Knowledge Base. PREREQUISITE: a Confluence component must be installed in your ByteChef deployment — the in-tree component set does not include one yet (see server/libs/modules/components/). When the component lands, replace the listPages_1 task type below with the actual `confluence/v1/<list-pages-action>` identifier.

inputs.name: spaceKey
inputs.label: Confluence Space Key
inputs.description: The space to sync, e.g. ENG.
